ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the notification-bell button did not open the dropdown in either Bablu or Admin Playwright runs (data-testid notification-dropdown not visible 800ms after click). Badge with unread count (9+) renders correctly. Possible cause: `useEffect` mousedown document-listener for outside-click closes dropdown before/while toggle. Suspect that React 18 batching + the mousedown handler ordering may flip `open` back to false, OR `ref.current.contains(e.target)` returns false when the click lands on the inner Bell SVG (contains should return true, but worth verifying). Manual click in browser likely works; recommend main agent verify by hand and consider switching the listener to `mousedown` capture-phase check + pointerdown ignore for the bell button itself, or use a `setOpen(true/false)` instead of toggle.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1347 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold flagged in iteration_2 and iteration_3. V4 added ~250 more lines. Strongly recommend splitting into routes/employee_portal.py, routes/notifications.py, routes/users.py to reduce regressions.

_enrich_leave performs 4 sequential awaits per leave (user, supervisor, leave_type, approver). For list_leaves and calendar with many rows this becomes O(N*4) DB calls. Consider batch lookups via $in or pre-fetched maps for production scale.

POST /api/leaves notifies every Director/Admin individually inside an async-for loop with separate insert_one calls per admin — fine for small teams but consider insert_many for atomicity + single round-trip.
DELETE /api/leaves only flips status to 'cancelled'; cannot be re-applied. Consider preventing cancel of approved leave that has already started (currently allows it).

list_leaves with scope=all does not filter by status param when status query is supplied (line 1058: `if status and scope != 'pending'` skips status if scope=='pending', but for scope=='all' status filter is correctly applied — minor readability concern).
Calendar endpoint loads ALL approved leaves when start/end omitted (no upper bound). Add `if not (start and end): raise 400` or default to current month to prevent unbounded reads.
balance computation iterates per leave-type and per leave row in Python. A single aggregate pipeline grouped by leave_type_id would be cleaner.
Notifications endpoint has no pagination cursor — only `limit`. Add `before` / `since` cursors before user notification volume grows.
No data-testid on header/page-title elements in EmployeeDashboard or LeaveTypes (page-level selectors used grid/page only).
JWT secret + admin password remain hard-coded fallbacks in server startup (carry-over from previous iterations).

rca_of_issue: Notification dropdown not opening under Playwright RCA hypothesis: NotificationBell.jsx attaches a document-level `mousedown` listener (line 35-38) at mount which fires BEFORE React's synthetic onClick. When Playwright clicks the bell button, mousedown propagates to document; the handler checks `ref.current.contains(e.target)` and only closes if outside. ref.current is the wrapper <div>, target is the inner <svg>/<path> from the Bell icon — DOM contains() should return true so the listener should NOT close it. However, if open is initially false and the toggle then sets it true, a second mousedown synthesised by Playwright (between mousedown/mouseup of the click) could re-fire and find e.target inside again. Most likely Playwright timing peculiarity rather than a user-facing bug. Mitigation: gate the document listener by `if (open)` and attach only during open state.
